Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling northbound in the left lane approaching an intersection in Houston, Texas, when the vehicle
was struck on its driver side by Driver 2, whose vehicle was eastbound and entered the intersection against a steady
signal. On arrival, I observed that the point of impact on Driver 1's vehicle was consistent with a broadside collision,
with crush damage concentrated along the driver door and quarter panel. The damage pattern corresponds closely to
the reported force of the impact. Driver 1 was seated in the driver's position and reported pain in the right shoulder,
which is consistent with the mechanism of this collision. A Passenger was also present in the front seat and was able
to confirm the sequence of events. Statements from two independent witnesses at the corner, along with photographs
taken at the scene, support the account given by Driver 1 and Driver 2 regarding how the collision occurred. Driver 2
acknowledged entering the intresection and did not dispute the sequence. No prior damage to Driver 1's vheicle was
known to any party at the scene. Driver 1 is listed as the named insured on the vehicle's policy.
